rules.statement: The father of a child born from a binna marriage has a right to inherit the property of that child, which is superior to the rights of more distant maternal relatives.
rules.supporting_quote: As a matter of construction I should have held that it (that is, Armour's opinion) was applicable only to cases where the claimants on the maternal line stood in a more remote degree of relationship to the propositus than that of great-aunt.
